arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
os.environ['BT']='1'
src=open('/workspace/tmp/tests/bigtest.py').read()
src=src.replace("main()\n","",1) if src.rstrip().endswith('main()') else src
src=src.replace("\nmain()\n","\n")
g={'__name__':'bt','__file__':'/workspace/tmp/tests/bigtest.py'}
exec(compile(src,'bigtest','exec'),g)
req=g['build'](1)
body=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'run.py'],input=body.encode(),cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True)
resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
for i,img in enumerate(resp['results'][0]['snapshots']):
    print('snap',i,'cells',img['cells'],'rows',sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']),'front64',len(img['front64']))
PY
